description.en: A new photo spreads from your press with a rippling ink edge and a thin lens distortion, while a soft image shadow changes behind the white card.
description.zh: 新图从点击位置沿不规则墨水边缘向外晕开，边界带有轻微透镜折射，白色卡片后的柔焦色影同步换色。

keywords: 墨水 扩散 晕染 图片 轮播 点击 液态 遮罩 折射 ink bloom spread carousel WebGL Lorenzo Cabra Bencho

discovery.caveat: 本地图片过渡重建；不包含付费组件原始源码。

source.implementation: Independent instance-scoped WebGL1 shader, Canvas2D fallback and DOM controls, reusing the existing native six-framework lifecycle. Includes generated inline artwork and licensed Lucide icons; no paid Bencho source code.
source.license: Original design and image/source license not supplied or independently verified. Original footage, photos and Pro source are not redistributed. Four new images were generated for this reconstruction. Lucide icons retain their ISC notice.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Click the photo or the arrows to spread the next image from your press. Use Left/Right, Home or End; touch supports tapping, and rapid clicks continue from the current frame.
instructions.zh: 点击图片或左右按钮，从落点扩散切换。支持方向键、Home、End 和触屏轻点，快速连点时从当前画面继续。
